source_snapshot.items: GFX Poison Consumption Handling With ODECC
source_snapshot.procedure: After configuration check and unsafe log-clear instruction, execute sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -t 8, retrieve/decode OOB CPER attachment(s), then dump in-band CPER with sudo amdgpuras -C.
source_snapshot.criteria: Injection succeeds; newly generated CPER evidence identifies the target OAM and contains UMC/ext0/On-die ECC/Deferred plus GC/ext62/GfxGcError/Uncorrected poison-consumed data; in-band OAM and severity agree.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies amdgpuras/Redfish packages and injection risk but requests an FAE command despite the exact command being present and collapses the two required error sections into a generic hardware-error check.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; kept Pending for mapping, CPER schema, record count/order, propagation limits and recovery.

old_problem: The historical review treated target mapping, protected CPER access, exact event cardinality/order and recovery as one unresolved engineering decision. The source's maximum-ID/+1 shortcut and clear-logs step cannot safely prove the two required UMC and GC data sets.
disposition_reason: The source itself supplies the exact d0/b2/t8 command and authoritative field/severity oracle. ED-11/12/15/16/17/20/30 allow a gate-closed parameterized RAS case: runtime bindings, compatible tools, authenticated CPER collection and signed recovery are Project Configuration, not a reason to keep the review Pending. The review does not invent a fixed OEM container count or ordering; all new post-stimulus CPER artifacts must collectively contain both required records on the same mapped OAM and correlate with in-band evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2085, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2086 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00130-V003 / da153127ac6e8017 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The exact source command sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -t 8 is preserved; device 0 is a placeholder until an immutable UUID/BDF/OAM mapping proves the intended target.
The acceptance oracle is explicit: target-OAM UMC ext0 On-die ECC Deferred and target-OAM GC ext62 GfxGcError Uncorrected/Poison consumed, with in-band agreement.

A CPER envelope can contain multiple sections and concurrent logging can create multiple entries, so PASS is based on complete pre/post set difference and both required decoded records, not a guessed +1 count, maximum ID or unapproved order.
Compatible amdgpuras/cdump_analyzer versions, authenticated paginated Redfish access, runtime identity, isolation, propagation limits and recovery are explicit prerequisites.
Exactly one authorized injection is permitted; preserve logs and every new attachment, stop on unexpected propagation or instability, and never clear or automatically retry.
No amdgpuras, Redfish, CPER retrieval/decoding, injection, reset, recovery, log clear, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: GFX ODECC poison-consumption UMC-to-GC evidence correlation
test_case.purpose: Inject the approved GFX ODECC poison condition once on the mapped OAM and prove both deferred UMC on-die-ECC detection and uncorrected GC poison consumption through complete OOB CPER and matching in-band evidence.
required_package: Compatible approved amdgpuras and cdump_analyzer builds
Authenticated paginated Redfish Dump/Entries and attachment access over the protected management path
Immutable device-id 0 to GPU UUID/BDF/OAM/GFX/UMC map
Approved CPER field schema for UMC ext0 and GC ext62
Dedicated SUT window, console/power access, propagation limits and signed recovery
test_case.test_command: After read-only identity/tool/health checks and point approval, capture complete paginated OOB CPER and in-band baselines without clearing them; execute `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -t 8` exactly once; capture the full command output and health timeline; enumerate the full post-test CPER set, securely retrieve/checksum/decode every new attachment, then run `sudo amdgpuras -C`. Do not rely on maximum ID, a +1 assumption, tail-only logs, plaintext HTTP, log clearing or reinjection.
test_case.expected_result: The one authorized command completes as defined by the approved tool version; all newly attributable CPER data collectively contain a target-OAM UMC record with ext=0, On-die ECC and Deferred severity and a target-OAM GC record with ext=62, GfxGcError and Uncorrected/Poison-consumed severity. In-band CPER agrees on OAM and severity, no unapproved OAM is affected, and post-check health satisfies the signed recovery oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target identity, one successful authorized injection, complete pre/post CPER set difference, both exact decoded record matrices on the same intended OAM, matching in-band evidence, no unexpected propagation and completed recovery/health evidence. FAIL on wrong/missing field or OAM, only one of the two required records, in-band mismatch, extra unapproved propagation, instability or recovery failure. BLOCKED if mapping, compatible tools/schema, authenticated evidence path, authorization or recovery is unavailable.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target map, tool/schema compatibility, isolated window, propagation limit and recovery are approved.
Explicit point approval is required for exactly one poison injection.
Preserve all existing and new RAS/CPER/system evidence; do not clear logs.
Stop and quarantine on wrong OAM, unexpected records, GPU loss, instability or uncertain state; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved device/OAM map and tool versions
Authorization, isolation/recovery plan and complete pre-test topology/health/CPER manifests
Full exact-command output and timestamped system/GPU/RAS timeline
Authenticated pre/post entry manifests plus checksums and raw/decoded form of every new attachment
Decoded UMC/ext0/On-die-ECC/Deferred and GC/ext62/GfxGcError/Uncorrected-poison-consumed records on the same intended OAM
In-band -C agreement, collateral audit, post-health/recovery evidence and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, unexpected propagation, missing/mismatched record, GPU loss or instability, stop immediately, preserve first-failure evidence and do not reinject or clear. Apply only the pre-approved recovery; quarantine the SUT if the defined health state cannot be restored.

source_conflict.reason: The review rejects log clearing, maximum-ID and +1 shortcuts and replaces them with a complete set-difference/all-new-attachment oracle while preserving both UMC and GC coverage without inventing container count or order.

blocked.reason: Purpose, exact stimulus and acceptance fields are known; remaining identity, tool, access and recovery inputs are executable project configuration.
